story.fullStory:
Spinners's "Games People Play" — original release 1975. "Games People Play", also known as "'They Just Can't Stop It' The (Games People Play)", is a song recorded by the American R&B vocal group the Spinners.

Released in 1975 from their Pick of the Litter album, featuring lead vocals by Bobby Smith, it was a crossover success, spending a week at number 1 on the US Hot Soul Singles chart and peaking at number 5 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song fared better on the US Cash Box Top 100, peaking at number 2.
